lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The central horizontal row contains the largest and highest-intensity local maxima, with vertical spacing between major nodes maintaining a consistent pixel-distance ratio.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a rectangular grid. These intersections serve as the primary spatial anchors for the lateral patterning.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge feature is visible, characterized by a sharp luminance transition. It runs from the posterior margin of the head across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a highlight on the dorsal edge and a cast shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a distribution of approximately 15-20 small, circular high-luminance blobs. The density is highest in the posterior-distal quadrant of the fin's visible surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, non-conforming orange-pigmented circular mark is visible on the lower lateral flank, located superior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
